dashboardDescription: Review student questions where qualified teacher guidance can help.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Set availability and subjects so support requests can be routed clearly.

editor.invalidTime: Enter a valid start and end time.
editor.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

detail.title: Help Request
detail.description: Review the student's context and record the teacher follow-up.

outOfReach.title: This request is no longer open to you
outOfReach.body: It expired, or another teacher has taken it.

detail.changedElsewhere: Another teacher has taken this request, or it has changed. It has been reloaded — please check where it stands now.
detail.replyDescription: Record the intervention, next step, or follow-up the student needs.

attachments.label: Attachments

accept.title: Accept this request
accept.body: Accept the request before you reply. The student then sees that a teacher is on it.

accept.bodyClassroom: Accept the request. Then you can enter the classroom, where the student joins you.

ended.withdrawn: The student withdrew this request. There is nothing left to do.
ended.expired: This request expired before anyone accepted it. There is nothing left to do.

detail.resolveHint: Done helping? Mark the request resolved. You can still add a reply afterwards.

classroomHelp.title: Online classroom
classroomHelp.body: The student chose the online classroom. Help them there with the whiteboard and voice call. When you are done, mark the request resolved.

profile.title: Teacher Profile
profile.description: Your account details and the teaching coverage students are matched against.
profile.statusDescription: Operational state and latest profile update.
profile.coverageDescription: What students are routed to you for, and when.
profile.noSubjects: No subjects set yet, so no students can be routed to you.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.description: A help request assigned to you always appears in your notifications.

dispatchEmail.title: Email for new help requests
dispatchEmail.body: An email each time a help request is assigned to you, with the subject and a link. It never contains what the student wrote.

requests.empty: No teacher support requests are available.

reply.placeholder: Write the next step for the student.

unsafe.privateMarkers: Private markers cannot be sent in a teacher reply.

attachments.label: Attached pictures
attachments.needsText: Add a few words: a picture on its own cannot be sent yet.

errors.failed: This picture could not be added. Please try again.

moderationReport.submitted: Report sent. The administration will review it (case {{caseId}}).

automationConsole.description: Preview and approve batches of practice assignments from reviewed sources. Backend errors are shown as they are, never replaced by sample data.
